achievements.description: Complete "Law & Order" having committed at most 2 massacres.

achievements.name: Through Thick and Thick
achievements.description: Complete "Graveyard Shift" without anyone being hungry at any time.

achievements.name: Double Excellence
achievements.description: Fully develop two technological domains during "Method in Madness".

achievements.name: Daring but Careful
achievements.description: Complete "In Gold We Trust" with no more than 50 peons dead.

achievements.name: What Goes Around, Comes Around
achievements.description: Kill Joaquim Perez with the Cañón Calavera.

achievements.name: Vengeance Served Cold
achievements.description: Complete "As Good as Dead".

achievements.name: Drowned in Blood
achievements.description: Complete "Law & Order".

achievements.name: The Meaning of Life
achievements.description: Complete "Graveyard Shift".

achievements.name: A Gift Scorned
achievements.description: Complete "A Matter of Time".

achievements.name: Sanity Engineered
achievements.description: Complete "Method in Madness".

achievements.name: Everlasting Fame and Fortune
achievements.description: Complete "In Gold We Trust".

achievements.name: Raw Deal
achievements.description: Complete "Hard Times".

achievements.name: On Earth, as It Is in Hell
achievements.description: Establish Warren's new world order.

achievements.name: Requiem for a Gunfighter
achievements.description: Restore order in the Weird West.

achievements.name: Once Upon a Time in the Weird West

achievements.description: Complete a single Scenario on Hard difficulty, with both Ironman and Injuries enabled.

achievements.description: Complete every Scenario on Hard, every Scenario with Injuries and every Scenario with Ironman enabled.

achievements.description: Unlock all Trinkets in the game.

achievements.name: The Wild Bunch
achievements.description: Use at least 30 different characters during tactical encounters throughout the game.

achievements.name: Blind Justice
achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with blind shots (no line of sight)

achievements.name: Fight No More Forever
achievements.description: Complete any tactical mission without firing a shot.

achievements.name: Treasures of the Sierra Madre
achievements.description: Use 25 different usable items at least once.

achievements.name: Trickshooter
achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a bullet ricocheting off at least 3 different objects.

achievements.name: Brimstone Killer
achievements.description: Kill a demon while your character is in demon form.

achievements.name: Aces in the Hole
achievements.description: Assemble the Five of a Kind hand.

achievements.name: Fastest Gun in the West
achievements.description: Kill an enemy in the very first action in a tactical encounter.

achievements.name: Scars of Freedom
achievements.description: Complete 'Scars of Freedom'.

achievements.name: Dr Frankenstein
achievements.description: Complete any of the 'Golem' hands on a character and complete at least one combat encounter with that character.

achievements.name: Army of Two
achievements.description: Complete the train assault with just Libertee and Phineas in your posse.

achievements.name: High Stakes
achievements.description: Win a liver in a game of dice.

achievements.name: Human Resources
achievements.description: Collect at least 75 Ether from enemies fallen in one combat encounter.
